# Globe Telecom achieves excellent HR service delivery with Leena AI

A quarter of HR tickets missed their SLAs, and 1,000 timesheet tickets a month were checked by hand.

EVA now handles 99% of employee queries, and the helpdesk beats every target it was set.

![Globe Telecom](https://assets.leena.ai/images/resources/casestudies/v2/globe/feature_v2.webp)

Globe Telecom runs the largest mobile network in the Philippines. When the pandemic changed how and where its 8,339 people worked, employee expectations shifted with it, and HR leadership decided to revamp HR operations.

Since day one, Globe has doubled down on emerging technologies to deliver on its vision — Abot mo ang Mundo, making great things possible — and has always tried to empower its teams in every part of their daily work.

The warning signs were clear. **25% of tickets missed their SLAs**, most KPIs were not being met, and some issues were escalated to executives when they did not need to be.

Key takeaways

- A quarter of tickets missed SLA, and some escalations reached executives that did not need them.
- Requirements were gathered per group: employees, strategy and operations, and helpdesk staff.
- Weekly tickets fell from 3,200 to 600 within a week of launch.
- Average first response fell from 8 hours to 1 hour 49 minutes.

## Where HR operations were failing

HR leadership saw problems in six areas at once: data management, process handling, technology, analytics, SLA adherence and service delivery.

Left unattended, these gaps meant a dip in job satisfaction across the organisation and serious handicaps whenever HR started a new initiative.

**Data.** Most data came from manual sources and was prone to human error, so the teams lacked data-driven, predictive capability.

**Process.** Many back-end processes still ran on unintegrated legacy systems, which pushed up turnaround time. Timekeeping policies (OT, ACA, OIC and others) needed a revamp so they were easier to use for both employees and the back-end team.

**Service.** Ticket monitoring was manual, so tasks piled up, and there was no systematic escalation path. Timesheet verification was manual, with **1,000 tickets a month**, and so was loans monitoring. Data was unreliable enough that some tickets showed resolution times of zero to ten seconds — an impossible feat.

**Tools.** Without tools to handle these processes, every activity risked human error and a high turnaround time. The lack of automation also generated data discrepancies.

## What the helpdesk had to do

HR leadership was clear about the ideal state before choosing anything: automate HR processes with zero or minimal manual work, adhere strictly to preset SLAs and turnaround times, make employee self-service the norm, get actionable insight from dashboards and analytics, empower team members through HR initiatives, and optimise HR processes across the organisation.

The targets were concrete too: lift SLA adherence for employee queries from 85% to 95%, and automate the resolution of employee inquiries.

Most of this had to come through one powerful helpdesk. The envisioned features were a simple, easy interface; nudges; dashboards; WD and WP integrations; multiple levels of support; smart AI ticketing; and a feedback system. Leena AI's HR Service Delivery suite matched those aspirations, and could take Globe to that ideal state without diluting its company values.

Leena AI's team then worked closely with HR leadership and each stakeholder group. The analysis showed requirements varied across stakeholders, so each group's needs were captured separately.

> With EVA bot powered by Leena AI, we are able to tremendously improve our employee experience. 99% of employee queries are addressed real-time by the AI-powered chatbot. Helpdesk ticket resolution time was reduced by 2.5x and user satisfaction rating rose to 96%.

![Mark Anthony Dimaisip](https://assets.leena.ai/images/resources/casestudies/v2/globe/avatar_mark_anthony_dimaisip.webp)Mark Anthony DimaisipEmployee Experience Architect, Globe Telecom

## What Globe Telecom built

EVA covers Globe's HR policies, dynamic transactions, forms and the HR helpdesk on one interface. Processes that took hours or days became a matter of minutes.

What each group needed EVA to do

- EmployeesOne simple place to askAccurate answers in reasonable time, and no need to escalate general concerns to senior leaders.
- Strat OpsFewer inquiries, tracked casesA ticketing system, easy case tracking and different support levels for responding.
- HelpdeskHelp when the desk is closedInformation available 24/7, nudges, and easy escalation to the right support level.
- LeadersInsight and SLA controlDashboards, strict SLA adherence, summaries of top concerns and team performance.

The launch was met with great enthusiasm. The platform was easy to use and flexible enough to absorb workflow changes, so the service team could focus on resolving cases rather than answering inquiries.

## What changed

EVA met or beat every target it was given. Average weekly tickets dropped from 3,200 before EVA to 600 one week after launch, and 99% of queries are now assisted by the bot across four channels.

Average ticket resolution became 2.5x faster, from 24 hours to 9.5 hours, and average first response 4.4x faster, from 8 hours to 1.8 hours. Against target, average first response came in 126% better and average resolution 87.6% better. Precision came in 17.7% above target and satisfaction 18.2% above, across 157,434 messages with 100% fulfilment. Globe reports a 139% reduction in manual ticketing, with 99% of queries addressed by EVA.

Each group got what it asked for. Strategy and operations got dashboards, analytics-driven insight and strict SLA adherence. Helpdesk staff got a live view of ongoing tickets, automated SLA recording, self-tracking of performance and summaries of top concerns and team performance. Employees got a simple, easy platform with an automated feedback loop for continuous improvement.

| Measure | Target | Achieved |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accuracy | 100% | 100% |
| Precision | 80% | 95.5% |
| Satisfaction | 80% | 96% |
| Average resolution time | 24 hours | 9h 30m |
| Average first response time | 8 hours | 1h 49m |
| Total messages | — | 157,434 |
| Fulfilment | — | 100% |

> EVA is everything we hoped for. Every team is empowered with the functionalities and perks it provides. It has helped the service team meet SLA targets and reduced the need for manual intervention. For the employees, EVA gave them the power to get answers without frustration over long wait times.

![Lyn Canalita-Sebial](https://assets.leena.ai/images/resources/casestudies/v2/globe/avatar_lyn_canalita_sebial.webp)Lyn Canalita-SebialEmployee Services and HR Technology Head, Globe Telecom

## Lead the pack

SLA adherence became routine and turnaround times hit historic lows. Just as important, HR leadership now has reliable data on query resolution, knowledge, documents and notifications — a real view of the organisation's pulse.

Processes became low-touch, and the cases that still needed a person got better attention through to completion. The aspiration is to keep leading the industry while making great things possible.

Globe Telecom plans to extend EVA to all other HR processes and across every office.

> We plan to leverage the best in HR technology with Leena AI. The process of EVA's implementation showed us the impact of having a partner that understood our goals and aspirations. It has helped us not only empower employees but work with a greater focus on our larger business goals.

Globe Telecom operates the largest mobile network in the Philippines, with more than 86.6 million mobile subscribers. Its services include broadband, fixed-line telephony and remittances through GCash. Founded in 1935 and primarily owned by Singtel and the Ayala Corporation, it employs 8,339 people.
